title: achillea rupestris subsp. lucana
intro: Achillea rupestris subsp. lucana, commonly known as Alpine Yarrow or Lucanian Yarrow, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to the mountainous regions of Italy. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Achillea rupestris subsp. lucana include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
